headline: Ransomware Attack Hits Hangzhou Yokohama Tire Co., Halts Production and Steals Data
body: Hangzhou Yokohama Tire, a key player in the tire manufacturing industry, has been struck by a crippling ransomware attack. The cyber intrusion severely disrupted IT operations and industrial control systems at their plant near Hangzhou. Some production lines were forced to shut down temporarily while specialists work to restore functionalities in phases. Reports indicate that sensitive business documents may have been exfiltrated during the breach. Efforts are underway to assess and mitigate the full impact.
